# Tesla Revenue Expectations Investigation

**Insufficient evidence**

There is insufficient evidence to evaluate whether Tesla met its revenue expectations as no annual USD revenue observations or matching claims records were available for TSLA in the specified window [E5a8d242b1b] [Ebeb6ffc39c].

## What was knowable then

As of 2012-01-01, no annual USD revenue, net income, operating income, operating cash flow, or capex observations were available under supported XBRL tags for TSLA [E5a8d242b1b] [Ecd08ee3f75] [E993240bf47] [E88d6166853] [E28fbb4236b]. Furthermore, there were no matching claims records for TSLA revenue expectations in the date-bounded source [Ebeb6ffc39c].

## What happened later

No subsequent annual USD revenue or core financial observations under supported XBRL tags were retrieved for TSLA to test any historical revenue expectations [E85cefecf8d] [E83e55ed10b] [Ee23e67b107] [E8c3b79e56b] [E18793f8213]. Coverage limits and missing filing data preclude verification of outcomes [E1aa4fd0425].

## The peer test

Only TSLA was selected. Add a peer company to compare results.

## Cross-examination

No management promises or quantitative revenue forecasts were identified in the records for TSLA within the selected window [Ebeb6ffc39c]. Therefore, no verified management forecasts or testable revenue claims exist to compare against financial results [E5a8d242b1b].

## Limits

- Missing annual financial metrics for TSLA under supported XBRL tags in this window.
- No matching claims records for TSLA revenue expectations in the date-bounded source.
- Adjusted-close prices for TSLA are missing with a coverage gap on 2012-01-01.
